messages:
Sam K: heads-up — we've got another customer report of double-counted tokens after a retry/fanout from the proxy. looks like late arrival + finalization race again :/
Jess L: ugh. is this the same flow as last month where finalizer ran before ingest dedupe?
Sam K: similar but different. sequence: client -> gateway sharded -> async enrich -> publish -> consumer writes accounting. if the enrich path retries with a new envelope id we end up with a distinct fingerprint and accounting writes twice when finalization is applied later.
Rahul M: can we make the consumer idempotent by deriving a stable fingerprint from provenance instead of envelope id? e.g. `sha(event.trace_id + request_id + model_version)` so retries collapse.
Ava P: that helps but not perfect — some enrichers add ephemeral metadata (latency bins) which changes payload. need canonicalization rules. also concern: if we canonicalize too aggressively we might coalesce genuinely distinct requests. tradeoff.
Sam K: proposal: two-layer approach — 1) deterministic fingerprinting based on canonical fields (customer_id, user_request_id, prompt_hash, model_id) 2) a finalization marker/commit log stream that marks `finalized=true` up to watermark ts, and consumer only applies accounting for events <= finalized watermark unless `force_final` flagged by admin.
Jess L: so ingest writes raw events (never mutated), but accounting consumers consult the commit-log watermark before materializing charges. if event arrives after watermark, we stash and wait? how long?
Rahul M: add heuristics: short tail (<=5m) wait-and-apply; medium (5m-6h) put to reconciliation queue with shadow-accounting, long (>6h) mark as late and audit-only. those thresholds configurable per-customer.
Ava P: we also need a clear API boundary: ingest -> canonicalize -> emit canonical_event to accounting topic + provenance envelope to raw-topic. keep canonicalization deterministic and small.
Sam K: example canonical_event envelope we discussed:
```json
{"customer_id":"acct_123","prompt_hash":"sha256:...","model":"gpt-4x","seq_ts":1719998600}
```
Jess L: ack. we should also add an `ingest_fingerprint` header with algorithm version so replays with old algorithm are detectable.
metering-bot: alert: unusual late-event rate spike for acct_123 at 1719999000 — 120 events in 3m
Rahul M: for implementation: (1) add canonicalizer service with pinned rules + tests, (2) consumer consults commit-log (compact state store) before write, (3) shadow-accounting path writes deduped results to temp table for reconciliation.
Ava P: followups: RFC for canonicalization schema, ops runbook for applying `force_final`, and an e2e test harness that simulates retries + enrich mutations. can someone own the RFC?
Sam K: I can draft the RFC. will include perf estimates (latency impact <5ms for canonicalization on hot path, extra kafka topic + processing for commit-log). tagging @Jess L and @Rahul M for review. :thumbsup:
